name: search_images
description: Search for images — Wikimedia Commons, TheSportsDB, or the open web (SerpApi/Google Images)

output.description: JSON object with {results: [{title, url, width, height, mime, license, artist, source, thumbnail?}]}

params.name: provider
params.description: Image provider: 'commons' (Wikimedia Commons, keyless), 'sportsdb' (TheSportsDB team badges, keyless), or 'web' (open-web Google Images via SerpApi — requires credentials.serpapi.api_key passthrough)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return
